title: I’m Legally Obligated to Disclose This - Framework investment
summary: Linus Sebastian of Linus Tech Tips discloses that he has invested in Framework, the modular repairable laptop maker. He explains his reasoning and the commitments he is making to viewers about future coverage.
why: HN cites it as Linus's own explanation of why he invested in Framework and why outside investment suits a hardware company.

quote.text: Linus (Tech Tips) has a good video about why external investment is useful
